Yes, this handles long notes just as gracefully. The note expands right there in place when I ask for it, and it stays properly formatted — my "My note" heading and the full text all readable — rather than getting flattened or cut off. Then "Show less" folds it back into the compact card. And the important part: expanding or collapsing is only about how much I'm looking at, it doesn't touch or trim what I actually wrote — the note itself stays whole underneath.

So it's the same considerate pattern as the labels: keep the list quick to skim by default, but let me open up the full thing whenever I want it, without ever losing my own words. That's exactly right for my notes.
